scenes.title: AI Arrives
scenes.text: In twenty twenty two, a chatbot reached a million users in five days. Nothing spread faster before.

scenes.title: Words
scenes.text: These models learned from trillions of words, finding patterns in everything humans have ever written.

scenes.title: Predict
scenes.text: At its heart, AI simply guesses the next most likely word. But guess well enough and it starts to look a lot like real thinking.

scenes.title: Creates
scenes.text: Now it writes code, draws pictures, and composes music, turning plain words into finished work.

scenes.title: Faster
scenes.text: Tasks that once took a whole afternoon now take seconds, changing how millions of people work.

scenes.title: Hallucinate
scenes.text: It can sound confident while being completely wrong, so always check the important stuff yourself.

scenes.title: New Work
scenes.text: AI will not replace you. Someone using AI probably will. The tool rewards the curious.

scenes.title: Your Turn
scenes.text: This is the newest tool in history. What would you build with it if anything were possible?
